[[User:Wizardman|'''''Wizardman''''']] 21:36, 8 August 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept''' -- [[User:FayssalF|FayssalF]] - [[User talk:FayssalF|''Wiki me up''® ]] 13:00, 10 August 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept''' [[User:Casliber|Casliber]] ([[User talk:Casliber|talk]] '''·''' [[Special:Contributions/Casliber|contribs]]) 05:22, 11 August 2009 (UTC) =Final decision= ''All numbering based on [[/Proposed decision]], where vote counts and comments are also available.'' ==Principles== ===Decorum=== 1) Wikipedia users are expected to behave reasonably, calmly, and courteously in their interactions with other users; to approach even difficult situations in a dignified fashion and with a constructive and collaborative outlook; and to avoid acting in a manner that brings the project into disrepute. Unseemly conduct from all sides of a dispute, such as [[Wikipedia:No personal attacks|personal attacks]], [[Wikipedia:Civility|incivility]], [[Wikipedia:Assume good faith|assumptions of bad faith]], [[Wikipedia:Trolling|trolling]], [[Wikipedia:Harassment|harassment]], [[Wikipedia:Do not disrupt Wikipedia to illustrate a point|disruptive point-making]], and [[Wikipedia:Gaming the system|gaming the system]], is prohibited. :''Passed 11 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Talk pages=== 2) The purpose of a Wikipedia [[Wikipedia:talk page|talk page]] is to provide space for editors to discuss changes to its associated article or project page. Article talk pages should not be used by editors as platforms for their personal views or [[WP:SOAP|soapboxing]]. :''Passed 12 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Single purpose accounts=== 3) [[WP:SPA|Single purpose accounts]] are expected to contribute neutrally instead of following their own agenda and, in particular, should take care to avoid creating the impression that their [[WP:SPA|focus on one topic]] is non-neutral, which could strongly suggest that their editing is not compatible with the goals of this project. :''Passed 8 to 1, 2 abstained, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Edit warring=== 4) Edit-warring is harmful. When disagreements arise, users are expected to discuss their differences rationally rather than reverting ad infinitum. Revert rules should not be construed as an entitlement or inalienable right to revert, nor do they endorse reverts as an editing technique. :''Passed 12 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Business articles=== 5) Where a dispute exists at an article between editors who are or were customers of a business (that is described by that article), and editors are unable to edit in an [[WP:NPOV|unbiased manner]] due to their prior experiences of the products and services of that business, then attempts should be made to obtain [[WP:3O|third party opinions]], and to encourage editing of the article by editors with no prior knowledge of the company or the disputes. :''Passed 5 to 3, 3 abstained, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Allegations of improper conduct=== 6) When an editor of an article faces allegations of improper conduct, such as [[WP:OWN|article ownership]] or failing to deal with potential [[WP:COI|conflicts of interest]], then review of both sides of the dispute by uninvolved editors should be sought at the relevant noticeboards or the article talk page. If such independent reviews find cause for concern, then steps should be taken to deal with the issues raised. Such steps can include statements of disclosure in an editor's userspace, commitments to reduce involvement in an article, warning an editor for making groundless accusations, or agreeing to pursue further stages in [[WP:DR|dispute resolution]]. :''Passed 11 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ==Findings of fact== ===194x144x90x118=== 1){{userlinks|194x144x90x118}}, an editor since April 2009, has engaged in soapboxing on talk pages,[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&oldid=283583899&diff=283698593][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&oldid=283904451&diff=283905025][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&oldid=283972946&diff=283984159] personal attacks,[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User:194x144x90x118&diff=prev&oldid=297020485] edit warring,[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=289857447][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=291421617][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=291878515][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=299045246],[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk%3AScjessey&diff=292196609&oldid=292167597],[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=DreamHost&diff=305721881&oldid=305719783][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=305721920] and a lack of a desire to abide by policy[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=303048860]. The first attacks and soapboxing took place on [[DreamHost]] and its talkpage, but similar behavior has subsequently occurred on other subjects.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Krakatoa&diff=prev&oldid=297138128][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:European_Union&diff=prev&oldid=304394685][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:European_Union&diff=prev&oldid=305633096] :''Passed 12 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Prior editing history=== 2) Prior to [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special%3ALog&type=newusers&user=&page=User%3A194x144x90x118&year=&month=-1&tagfilter=&hide_patrol_log=1 registering an account], 194x144x90x118 [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&limit=100&target=194.144.90.118 edited as an unregistered user] from April 2007 to April 2009. :''Passed 12 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Locus of the dispute=== 3) The locus of the dispute between {{user|194x144x90x118}} and {{user|Scjessey}} is the [[DreamHost]] article, an article that was created in [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=DreamHost&oldid=19944878 July 2005]. Scjessey has edited the article since February 2006. The most recent set of disputes started in March and April 2009, and also included {{user|Judas278}} and administrator {{admin|SarekOfVulcan}}, among others. :''Passed 12 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Editing by new users=== 4) One of the accounts involved in this dispute, Judas278, who [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Judas278&diff=prev&oldid=301280606 retired on 9 July 2009], was a [[WP:SPA|single-purpose account]] that made 282 edits from March to July 2009, all to the [[DreamHost]] article ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?limit=100&tagfilter=&title=Special%3AContributions&contribs=user&target=Judas278&namespace=0&tagfilter=&year=&month=-1 69 edits]), its talk page, or related discussions. 194x144x90x118, another account involved in this dispute, has made over 500 edits since registering in April 2009, with [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&limit=100&contribs=user&target=194x144x90x118&namespace=0 81 article space edits] split mainly between Icelandic/Norse history, the Bobby Fischer article and related chess articles, and the DreamHost article (12 edits). The majority of the editing by Judas278 and 194x144x90x118 has been to article talk pages and user talk pages. :''Passed 11 to 1, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Prior incidents and dispute resolution=== 5) The history of disputes and dispute resolution at the DreamHost article since March 2009 includes threads at the administrators noticeboard ([[Wikipedia:Administrators'_noticeboard/IncidentArchive527#Problems_at_DreamHost_with_an_SPA|1]], [[Wikipedia:Administrators'_noticeboard/IncidentArchive530#IP_comments_at_Dreamhost|2]]), several blocks and article protection for two months, along with a period of talk page semi-protection ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special%3ALog&type=block&user=SarekOfVulcan&page=User%3A194.144.90.118&year=2009&month=4&tagfilter=], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special%3ALog&type=protect&user=&page=DreamHost&year=2009&month=4&tagfilter=], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special%3ALog&type=&user=&page=Talk%3ADreamHost&year=2009&month=5&tagfilter=&hide_patrol_log=1], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Log&offset=20090505&type=block&user=SarekOfVulcan&limit=2], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special%3ALog&type=protect&user=&page=DreamHost&year=2009&month=5&tagfilter=&limit=1]), extensive talk page discussions ([[Talk:DreamHost/Archive 3|1]], [[Talk:DreamHost/Archive 4|2]]), informal mediation from the Mediation Cabal ([[Talk:DreamHost/Archive_5#Informal_mediation|1]], [[Talk:DreamHost/Archive_5#Informal_mediation_.28continued.29|2]]), more ANI threads ([[Wikipedia:Administrators'_noticeboard/IncidentArchive541#User:194x144x90x118|1]], [[Wikipedia:Administrators'_noticeboard/IncidentArchive541#User:194x144x90x118_2|2]]), an article request for comments ([[Talk:DreamHost/Archive_6#RfC:_Does_the_.22Incidents.22_section_have_undue_weight_concerns.3F|1]]), a rejected request for arbitration ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case&oldid=302234480#DreamHost]), a user conduct request for comments ([[Wikipedia:Requests for comment/194x144x90x118|1]]), and finally an accepted request for arbitration ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case&oldid=307626059#194x144x90x118]). In addition (since the article's creation), there have been three deletion discussions ([[Wikipedia:Articles for deletion/Bravenet Web Services|1]], [[Wikipedia:Articles for deletion/DreamHost|2]], [[Wikipedia:Articles for deletion/DreamHost (2nd nomination)|3]]), a request for Editor assistance ([[Wikipedia:Editor_assistance/Requests/Archive_33#Am_I_less_biased.3F|1]]), and (more recently) requests for advice from venues such as WikiProject Companies, the Conflict of interest noticeboard, the Content noticeboard, and the Neutral point of view noticeboard ([[Wikipedia_talk:WikiProject_Companies#Dispute_on_notability.2C_sourcing.2C_and_contents_of_DreamHost|1]], [[Wikipedia:Conflict_of_interest/Noticeboard/Archive_34#DreamHost|2]], [[Wikipedia:Content_noticeboard/Archive2#DreamHost_dispute|3]], [[Wikipedia:Neutral_point_of_view/Noticeboard/Archive_6#DreamHost_dispute_-_proposed_changes|4]]). Not all requests for advice gained a response. :''Passed 12 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Nature of the dispute=== 6) Several of the past and current editors, including several of those engaged in disputes at the [[DreamHost]] article, are self-identified customers or former customers of the company. One of the points disputed during the talk page discussions was editorial objectivity when discussing article content related to criticisms and praise of the company [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User:Scjessey&diff=next&oldid=40053047], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=prev&oldid=139968284], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=prev&oldid=170960585], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=prev&oldid=222627327], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=prev&oldid=125559540], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/Incidents&diff=prev&oldid=280751202], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=prev&oldid=288904992] (last paragraph). :''Passed 11 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Concerns of third parties=== 7) Third parties, without prior involvement in the dispute, have expressed concern about issues of [[WP:OWN|article ownership]] and potential [[WP:COI|conflicts of interest]] relating to Scjessey's editing of the [[DreamHost]] article [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=prev&oldid=238277781], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=prev&oldid=139894812], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=prev&oldid=283826762], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk%3ADreamHost&diff=283967973&oldid=283933341], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Conflict_of_interest/Noticeboard&diff=prev&oldid=301218447]. Scjessey has consistently rejected such concerns [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=238839833], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=139894812], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=283827700], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:DreamHost&diff=next&oldid=283999499], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Conflict_of_interest/Noticeboard&diff=next&oldid=301221015]. :''Passed 8 to 1, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Disclosure and other commitments=== 8) Scjessey, a long-time contributor to the [[DreamHost]] article, disclosed that he was a DreamHost user [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User:Scjessey&diff=next&oldid=40053047] before he started editing the article in 2006, and made various other disclosures over the following three years. Following discussions related to the recent disputes, he created a [[User:Scjessey/COI|COI notice]] in his userspace on 5 July, followed by a fuller [[User:Scjessey/DreamHost|disclosure notice]] on 9 July. In addition to this, Scjessey made a commitment at the conflict of interest noticeboard to [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Conflict_of_interest/Noticeboard&diff=prev&oldid=301221182 scale back] his involvement in the article following the resolution of the disputes. :''Passed 12 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ==Remedies== ''Note: All remedies that refer to a period of time, for example to a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months, are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' ===194x144x90x118 banned=== 1) {{userlinks|194x144x90x118}} is banned from Wikipedia for a period of one year. :''Passed 12 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ===Editors reminded=== 2) All editors of the [[DreamHost]] article are reminded to abide by Wikipedia's policies of [[WP:NPOV|neutral point of view]], using [[WP:RS|reliable]] and [[WP:V|verifiable]] sources; to engage in [[WP:CIVL|civil]] discussion on the talk page to resolve editorial disputes; and to use the relevant noticeboards and dispute resolution processes to seek external opinions on coverage of matters where the current editors may lack objectivity. :''Passed 12 to 0, 02:41, 10 September 2009 (UTC)'' ==Log of blocks, bans, and restrictions== Log any block, restriction, ban or extension under any remedy in this decision here. Minimum information includes name of administrator, date and time, what was done and the basis for doing it. [[Category:Wikipedia arbitration cases|{{SUBPAGENAME}}]] {{NOINDEX}}

{{ArbComNav}} '''Case Opened''' on 17:06, 23 May 2009 (UTC)
'''Case Closed''' on 23:54, 30 June 2009 (UTC)
Watchlist all case pages: [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}&action=watch '''1'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Evidence&action=watch '''2'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Workshop&action=watch '''3'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Proposed_decision&action=watch '''4''']
Please do not edit this page directly unless you are an Arbitrator or a Committee clerk Statements on this page are original comments provided when the Committee was initially requested to Arbitrate this page (at [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration|Requests for arbitration]]), and serve as opening statements; as such, they should not be altered. Evidence for this case is at [[/Evidence]]. Suggested principles, findings, and remedies were posted at [[/Workshop]]. That page may also be used for general comments on the evidence. The Arbitrators voted on a final decision in the case at [[/Proposed decision]]. Editors may add to the [[#Log of blocks, bans, and restrictions]] as needed, but this page should not be edited otherwise. Please raise any questions at [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration#Requests for clarification]], and report violations of this decision at [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard/Arbitration enforcement]]. ==Involved parties== * {{Admin|A Man In Black}} * {{Admin|Rootology}} * {{Userlinks|Ikip}} (Added June 1) ===Requests for comment=== * None. == Statement by Rootology == A Man In Black was [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:A_Man_In_Black&oldid=291108314 blocked today] for his 12th incident of blatant edit warring since his [[Wikipedia:Requests for adminship/A Man In Black|2005 successful RFA]]. He has an extensive and long-term history of edit warring, which is unbecoming of an administrator. Reviewing his block log, which I never actually noticed before tonight, I count 12 valid blocks imposed by other administrators due to his ongoing misbehavior:
1. July 17, 2006: 3RR; 2. December 30, 2006: 3RR; 3. February 9, 2007: 3RR; 4. February 28, 2007: 3RR; 5. March 5, 2007: 3RR; 6. March 9, 2007: 3RR; 7. March 12, 2007: 3RR; 8. March 30, 2007: 3RR; 9. November 19, 2007: edit warring; 10. September 13, 2008: 3RR; 11. February 5, 2009: 3RR; 12. May 20, 2009: 3RR.
He routinely does this ('''[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Log&type=block&page=User:A_Man_In_Black view his block log]'''), and it is an ongoing pattern. Any non-admin warring this often would, at the very least, be any of the following: # Indefinitely blocked # Forced to take a 0RR or 1RR restriction from the community or Arbitration Committee # Be facing some edit restrictions. In the wake of this latest block, as is often this user's general tone, he is unrelenting in his positions and views, which is at the least unhelpful and likely not acceptable administrative behavior by modern 2009 Wikipedia standards. This one block sequence in particular is troubling, and basically on the surface seems to encapsulate how he views certain things: # 09:31, March 30, 2007 A Man In Black (talk | contribs | block) unblocked "A Man In Black (talk | contribs)" ‎ (Leaving) # 09:04, March 30, 2007 Dominic (talk | contribs | block) blocked A Man In Black (talk | contribs) (anon. only) with an expiry time of 48 hours ‎ (3RR at Template:Grand Theft Auto games, prior history of blocks for edit warring (see user talk page)) (unblock | change block) This user in this instance was edit warring with [[User:Ikip]], his principle opponent on the whole inclusion/deletion war, who he had previously blocked on April 26, twenty three days ago, as detailed [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/IncidentArchive533&oldid=287729663#Blocked_Ikip_for_canvassing here] for alleged canvassing about the [[Wikipedia:Article Rescue Squadron]], which AMiB also put up for MFD at [[Wikipedia:Miscellany for deletion/Wikipedia:Article Rescue Squadron (4th nomination)]]. AMiB also created [[User:A Man In Black/Let's tape Ikip up in a box and mail him to the moon]], and [[:Template:AfD/Tagged]], made again by Ikip, which AMiB [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Log&page=Template%3AAfD%2FTagged deleted not once but twice in two days] claiming [[WP:POINT]]. Others can supply other more recent evidence of his edit warring at recent RFCs. In short, this is an ongoing pattern that shows no signs of stopping now over the course of ''years''. I ask the Committee to: # Review AMiB's status and standing as an administrator in light of this ongoing history, and committment to edit warring and disruption. # Review AMiB's actions of using admin tools in a dispute (the block of Ikip). # Should AMiB retain his tools, face a permanent restriction of their use in regards to Ikip. # Should AMiB retain his tools, face a permanent restriction of their use in regards to anything related to our xFD processes, "broadly construed", if evidence is presented of misuse related to this (which seems often hinted at, but I can't find at a quick glance). # Strongly consider a 0RR or 1RR permanent restriction on him on all parts of Wikipedia, enforceable by block by uninvolved administrators. Thanks. [[User:Rootology|rootology]] ([[Special:Contributions/Rootology|C]])([[User talk:Rootology|T]]) 05:17, 20 May 2009 (UTC) ;Quick answers # John: That is common for placement of Article FAQs, location-wise, that I've seen. [[User:Rootology|rootology]] ([[Special:Contributions/Rootology|C]])([[User talk:Rootology|T]]) 16:18, 20 May 2009 (UTC) # Bainer: I won't have time to look myself for a day or two, but I suspect others are reviewing this indepth right now. A quick look however turns up [[:Template:AfD/Tagged]], made again by Ikip, which AMiB [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Log&page=Template%3AAfD%2FTagged deleted not once but twice in two days] claiming [[WP:POINT]]. That's 3x now that he--deeply involved in the metawars of AFD with Ikip--used his tools in regards to Ikip. [[User:Rootology|rootology]] ([[Special:Contributions/Rootology|C]])([[User talk:Rootology|T]]) 16:18, 20 May 2009 (UTC) # MZMcBride, Stifle, Ncmvocalist: As Casliber said, any RFC over any of these people is going to fall apart into partisan sqawking like the various "Characters" things with people like TTN & Pixelface before, on the 1st generation of these wars. These people are wholly entrenched, and the issue is AMiB's ongoing patterns of behavior which are frankly unbecoming of an administrator--he's argumentative, intractable, prone by clear evidence to edit war, used his tools repeatedly vs. a user he is involved with (Ikip) and then when finally blocked for 3RR ''again'' for 9 days for the latest incident, promptly blamed Ikip for the whole thing on his talk page. If a Checkuser/Oversight member was removed of his status for edit warring over years without a block in place, [[Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration/West_Bank_-_Judea_and_Samaria#Jayjg_stripped_of_status_and_privileges|as seen here]], then surely someone is unfit to be an administrator having picked up 12 '''blocks''' for edit warring since becoming an admin. Administrator is not some special rank and priviledge that gives us any more leeway on bad behavior--if some non-admin here since 2005 as I have been edit warred and was blocked 3 days, and I did the same thing in similar to matching circumstances, I damned well better pick up a 3 day block myself--or any other admin who did so, up to and including Jimmy--or our entire system of governance is a farce. [[User:Rootology|rootology]] ([[Special:Contributions/Rootology|C]])([[User talk:Rootology|T]]) 16:18, 20 May 2009 (UTC) # Roger: AMiB does do some infrequent valid admin work, but his block record is unbecoming of an admin, especially as all of that is ''post''-RFA. A hard 0RR or 1RR per week with standard incrementing block enforcement to force discussion over warring, or a broadly construed topic-ban with block enforcement on some combination of: a) *fD related areas; b) Article Rescue Squadron specifically; c) User:Ikip; d) fiction topics would probably eliminate any disruption (but would need a full case with evidence to review). It seems looking quickly that those are the main areas that get AMiB in hot water. If possible, I'd say just the hard block-enforced 0RR or 1RR per week would be fine at the least, but I defer to the AC's collective wisdom. [[User:Rootology|rootology]] ([[Special:Contributions/Rootology|C]])([[User talk:Rootology|T]]) 17:56, 20 May 2009 (UTC) ;Request by Rootology, AMiB unblock & Information request 1. Since we're at 11 accepts and the case will be opening, can we get him unblocked with the condition that until the 9 days expire he limit himself to editing the RFAR pages, his own user space to draft evidence, and not use admin tools till the 9 are up? [[User:Rootology|rootology]]/[[Wikipedia:Equality|equality]] 15:31, 23 May 2009 (UTC) 2. Will we be able to refer to the private evidence at least in general terms (the specific policy violation) when presented our own evidence and workshop proposals? [[User:Rootology|rootology]]/[[Wikipedia:Equality|equality]] 15:52, 23 May 2009 (UTC) == Statement by A Man In Black == The first I've heard of Rootology's (rather scattered) objections to me or my conduct is this RFAr. His second post on my talk page ever was notifying me of this RFAr. If he's worried about my editing habits or my administrative actions, there are more-appropriate venues and less adversarial ways to engage me other than going first to RFAr and demanding I be deadminned. - [[User:A Man In Black|A Man In '''Bl♟ck''']] ([[User talk:A_Man_In_Black|conspire]] - [[Special:Contributions/A Man In Black|past ops]]) 05:56, 20 May 2009 (UTC) ==Preliminary decisions== ===Arbitrators' opinions on hearing this matter (11/0/2/3) === *'''Accept'''  [[User:Roger Davies|'''Roger Davies''']] [[User talk:Roger Davies|'''talk''']] 07:07, 21 May 2009 (UTC) :*'''Questions''': (Q1) For a cursory glance at the logs, this editor does not appear to use the tools much. What does he need them for? I'd appreciate responses (with some numbers) from both sides of the debate. (Q2) As a further thought, do the parties think this could be resolved with a 1RR restriction? I'm particularly interested in hearing from A Man in Black on this.  [[User:Roger Davies|'''Roger Davies''']] [[User talk:Roger Davies|'''talk''']] 07:08, 20 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Question''': Could someone explain why [[Wikipedia talk:Article Rescue Squadron/FAQ]] is in namespace "Wikipedia talk" (5) instead of "Wikipedia" (4)? [[User:Jayvdb|John Vandenberg]] '''([[User talk:Jayvdb|chat]])''' 07:52, 20 May 2009 (UTC) ** '''Accept'''. [[User:Jayvdb|John Vandenberg]] '''([[User talk:Jayvdb|chat]])''' 23:46, 22 May 2009 (UTC) ** In regards to Rootology's questions, 1) can a clerk please talk with AMiB about an unblock so he can participate in this case, and 2) if anyone is not sure whether evidence can be publicly posted due to privacy concerns, either talk to the person whose privacy may be affected, or send it to arbcom-l and we will help with that decision - if it needs to stay private, we may advise that a public note can be made to describe it in a manner that doesnt affect privacy. [[User:Jayvdb|John Vandenberg]] '''([[User talk:Jayvdb|chat]])''' 16:35, 23 May 2009 (UTC) *'''recused''' - non-impartial. [[User:Casliber|Casliber]] ([[User talk:Casliber|talk]] '''·''' [[Special:Contributions/Casliber|contribs]]) 09:59, 20 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''. Blocks should give an user ample notice that their conduct is problematic, especially if the user is a long time contributor and an administrator. This situation needs to be addressed in a way that gives a clearly decisive finding and remedy. The best outcome will be from an ArbCom case. [[User:FloNight|FloNight]][[User talk:FloNight|♥♥♥]] 12:27, 20 May 2009 (UTC) **Private information received by ArbCom by email. AMIB has been notified and is aware of the concerns. [[User:FloNight|FloNight]][[User talk:FloNight|♥♥♥]] 18:48, 21 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept''' per FloNight. [[User:Wizardman|'''''Wizardman''''']] 14:09, 20 May 2009 (UTC) *Question: without turning this into an evidence page, are there any instances of tool usage that are of concern apart from the Ikip block? --[[User:Stephen Bain|bainer]] ([[User_talk:Stephen Bain|talk]]) 14:40, 20 May 2009 (UTC) **Accept based on information provided here and to the Committee by email. --[[User:Stephen Bain|bainer]] ([[User_talk:Stephen Bain|talk]]) 04:20, 22 May 2009 (UTC) *Awaiting answers to the questions posed by my colleagues. I would also welcome a more detailed statement from A Man In Black. In that regard, unless there is a serious objection, I am prepared to unblock him for the limited purpose of allowing him to edit this page (and the case pages, if the request is accepted). Disclosure: I have an entry in A Man In Black's block log; it is two years old, and I will not be recusing based upon it, but thought I should mention it. [[User:Newyorkbrad|Newyorkbrad]] ([[User talk:Newyorkbrad|talk]]) 15:26, 20 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Recuse''' - I had commented on the most recent block of A Man in Black prior to this request being initiated. [[User:Risker|Risker]] ([[User talk:Risker|talk]]) 19:00, 20 May 2009 (UTC) Note: Carcharoth was correct in removing my double vote; I was away for a few days and forgot that I had already recused.. [[User:Risker|Risker]] ([[User talk:Risker|talk]]) 13:08, 23 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''. [[User:Kirill Lokshin|Kirill]] [[User talk:Kirill Lokshin|[talk]]] [[User:Kirill Lokshin/Professionalism|[pf]]] 03:23, 21 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Recuse''' - extended involvement in the ANI thread concerning AMIB and Jtrainor. [[User:Carcharoth|Carcharoth]] ([[User talk:Carcharoth|talk]]) 08:18, 21 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''. While I don't necessarily accept the theory that a long history of blocks of an admin makes a ''prima facie'' argument for accepting a case, the evidence submitted by Ikip certainly does. Per Flonight the prolonged history here is troubling. [[User:Sam Blacketer|Sam Blacketer]] ([[User talk:Sam Blacketer|talk]]) 08:30, 21 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''. — [[User:Rlevse|Rlevse]] • [[User_talk:Rlevse|Talk]] • 20:17, 21 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''; I also tend to agree that an RfCU is unlikely to be productive given the volatility of the incipient dispute that led to those incidents and the (regrettable) party lines that have been drawn. — [[User:Coren|Coren]] [[User Talk:Coren|(talk)]] 01:27, 22 May 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''. -- [[User:FayssalF|FayssalF]] - [[User talk:FayssalF|''Wiki me up''® ]] 17:07, 22 May 2009 (UTC) ===Temporary injunction (none)=== =Final decision = ''All numbering based on [[/Proposed decision]], where vote counts and comments are also available.'' ==Principles== ===Editor conduct=== 1) Wikipedia editors are expected to behave reasonably, calmly, and courteously in their interactions with other editors; to approach even difficult situations in a dignified fashion and with a constructive and collaborative outlook; and to avoid acting in a manner that brings the project into disrepute. Unseemly conduct, such as [[Wikipedia:No personal attacks|personal attacks]], [[Wikipedia:Civility|incivility]], [[Wikipedia:Assume good faith|assumptions of bad faith]], [[Wikipedia:Harassment|harassment]], [[Wikipedia:Do not disrupt Wikipedia to illustrate a point|disruptive point-making]], and [[Wikipedia:Gaming the system|gaming the system]], is prohibited. :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Editorial process=== 2) Wikipedia works by building [[Wikipedia:Consensus|consensus]] through the use of polite discussion—involving the wider community, if necessary—and [[Wikipedia:Dispute resolution|dispute resolution]], rather than through disruptive editing. Editors are each responsible for noticing when a debate is escalating into an [[Wikipedia:Edit war|edit war]], and for helping the debate move to better approaches by discussing their differences rationally. This applies to any and all pages on Wikipedia, from Articles to Templates to Project space. :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Edit warring=== 3) Edit-warring, whether by [[Wikipedia:Reversion|reversion]] or otherwise, is prohibited; this is so even when the disputed content is clearly problematic, with [[Wikipedia:Three-revert rule#Exceptions|very limited exceptions]]. The [[Wikipedia:Three-revert rule|three-revert rule]] does not entitle users to revert a page three times each day, nor does it endorse reverting as an editing technique. :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Good faith and disruption=== 4) Inappropriate behavior driven by good intentions is still inappropriate. Editors acting in good faith may still be sanctioned when their actions are disruptive. :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Recidivism=== 5) Users who have been sanctioned for improper conduct are expected to avoid repeating it should they continue to participate in the project. Failure to do so may lead to the imposition of increasingly severe sanctions. :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Administrators=== 6) [[Wikipedia:Administrators|Administrators]] are trusted members of the community. They are expected to lead by example and to behave in a respectful, civil manner in their interactions with others. Administrators are expected to follow Wikipedia policies and to perform their duties to the best of their abilities. Occasional mistakes are entirely compatible with adminship; administrators are not expected to be perfect. However, sustained poor judgment or multiple violations of policy (in the use of Administrator tools, or otherwise) may result in the removal of administrator status. Administrators are also expected to learn from experience and from justified criticisms of their actions. :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Disruption by administrators=== 7) Because of their position of trust in the community, administrators are held to a higher standard of behavior than non-administrators. Sustained disruption of Wikipedia is incompatible with the status of administrator. Administrators who repeatedly and aggressively engage in inappropriate activity may be desysopped by the Arbitration Committee. :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Administrators involved in disputes=== 7A) Administrator tools are not to be used in connection with disputes in which the administrator is involved as an editor. In several recent instances, administrators involved in disputes over an issue or with a user have taken sysop actions relating to that dispute and then referred the actions a noticeboard for endorsement or review. This practice generally is not sufficient to comply with [[WP:UNINVOLVED|policy]] against action by "involved" administrators. In such circumstances, the administrator should not take the action but should instead report the issue to the noticeboard, perhaps with a suggestion for appropriate action, to be dealt with by another administrator. In limited circumstances, such as blatant vandalism or bad-faith harassment, an involved administrator may act, but such exceptions are likely to be rare. :''Passed 9 to 0 on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Baiting=== 8) Editing in a manner so as to provoke other editors goes against established Wikipedia policies, as well as the spirit of Wikipedia and the will of its editors. Editing in such a manner may be perceived as trolling and harassment. :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Canvassing=== 9) Excessive cross-posting, campaigning, votestacking, stealth canvassing, and forum shopping are inappropriate forms of [[WP:CANVASS|canvassing]]. Signs of biased canvassing include urging new editors to take a specific position in a conflict and only contacting one side of a dispute. To protect against rigged decisions, editors participating due to questionable canvassing may be discounted when evaluating consensus. :''Passed 9 to 0 (with 1 abstention) on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Arbitration in dispute resolution=== 10) A request for arbitration is the last step of dispute resolution on Wikipedia. With limited exceptions (such as emergency situations, "unusually divisive disputes among administrators", and matters directly referred by Jimbo Wales), it is expected that other avenues of dispute resolution will have been exhausted before an arbitration case is filed. Arbitration is the last resort for conflicts, rather than the first. :''Passed 5 to 2 (with 3 abstentions) on 19:19, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ==Findings of fact== ===A Man In Black’s edit-warring and block log=== 1) {{userlinks|A Man In Black}}, an administrator, has been blocked approximately 12 times for edit warring since his request for adminship in October 2005.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Log&type=block&page=User%3AA+Man+In+Black] :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:29, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Disputes between A Man In Black and Ikip=== 2.1) A Man In Black and {{userlinks|Ikip}} have been involved in a series of disputes involving the [[Wikipedia:Article Rescue Squadron]]. Their total contributions have intersected about 20% of the time as of May 23, including 26 edits by A Man In Black to Ikip’s talk page. See [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/A Man In Black/Evidence#A Man In Black is deeply involved with Ikip|evidence]]. :''Passed 8 to 0 (with 1 abstention) on 19:29, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===A Man In Black’s block of Ikip=== 3.1) On April 26, A Man In Black blocked Ikip for canvassing in connection with the pending AfD of a fictional television character. A Man In Black then reported his block of Ikip on the administrators' noticeboard and invited review. The resulting discussion resulted in an unblock. [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/IncidentArchive533&oldid=287729663#Blocked_Ikip_for_canvassing] In view of their past history, A Man In Black should not have blocked Ikip but, if he had a concern, should have raised it on ANI for attention by other administrators rather than carry out the block himself. :''Passed 8 to 1 (with 1 abstention) on 19:29, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===A Man in Black's blocks of Jtrainor and MalikCarr=== 3A) In October and November 2008, A Man in Black blocked both {{userlinks|Jtrainor}} and {{userlinks|MalikCarr}} while in content disputes with them relating to the infobox [[Template:Infobox Mobile Suit]] and its use in a number of articles: # On 25 October, A Man in Black [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Infobox_Mobile_Suit&diff=247656071&oldid=247583516 removed] a number of parameters from the infobox, with the edit summary "Dumping a bunch of unencyclopedic in-universe detail..." A Man in Black then proceeded to edit war with {{userlinks|TheFarix}} and Jtrainor over his changes ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Infobox_Mobile_Suit&action=history&offset=200810252207&dir=prev&limit=36 history]). # On 29 October, A Man in Black [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Gundam_(mobile_suit)&diff=248359045&oldid=247595705 edited] the [[Gundam (mobile suit)]] article, to remove several parameters from the instance of Infobox Mobile Suit transcluded there, with the edit summary "Copyvio from http://www.gundamofficial.com/worlds/uc/msg/mechanics/ms_gundam.html" (a page on the "GundamOfficial" site). A Man in Black then edit warred with Jtrainor and {{userlinks|Kyaa the Catlord}} over these changes ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Gundam_%28mobile_suit%29&action=history&offset=200810290631&dir=prev&limit=7 history]). # Also on 29 October, A Man in Black [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=MSN-03_Jagd_Doga&diff=248353116&oldid=228742550 edited] the [[MSN-03 Jagd Doga]] article to again remove parameters from the infobox, with the edit summary "rm blatant copyvio from http://www.gundamofficial.com/worlds/uc/cca/mechanics/ms_jagdgyunei.html" (a page on the "GundamOfficial" site). He then [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=MSN-03_Jagd_Doga&diff=248355632&oldid=248355597 tagged] the article with the {{tl|primarysources}} template, and then edit warred with Jtrainor and MalikCarr over these changes ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=MSN-03_Jagd_Doga&action=history&offset=20081029055029&dir=prev&limit=25 history]). # A Man in Black was aware that the GundamOfficial site was the source of the information in the infobox as early as November 2007 ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template_talk:Infobox_Mobile_Suit&diff=prev&oldid=168908086]). # The same users had been involved in a similar edit war in 2007 ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=MSN-03_Jagd_Doga&offset=20071101000000&limit=100&action=history], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=MSN-04_Sazabi&offset=20071101000000&limit=100&action=history], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=MSN-02_Zeong&offset=20071101000000&limit=100&action=history]) that ultimately ended in [[Wikipedia:Requests for mediation/Gundam|a request for mediation]]. # On 1 November, A Man in Black [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special%3ALog&type=block&user=A+Man+In+Black&page=User%3AJtrainor&year=&month=-1&tagfilter= blocked] Jtrainor for 24 hours with the action summary "Replacing copyvio into articles". On 2 November, A Man in Black [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special%3ALog&type=block&user=A+Man+In+Black&page=User%3AMalikCarr&year=&month=-1&tagfilter= blocked] MalikCarr for 24 hours with the action summary "Trying to force copyvio into [[MSN-03 Jagd Doga]]". The blocks were discussed at the [[Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/IncidentArchive489#Review_of_A_Man_In_Black.27s_block_of_Jtrainor|administrators' incidents noticeboard]]. # It was not appropriate for A Man in Black to have performed the two blocks, given his substantial prior history of conflict with the two users blocked, and his involvement with the editorial dispute that led to the blocks (both in the immediate context and a year previously). :''Passed 8 to 0 on 01:05, 1 July 2009 (UTC).'' ===A Man In Black has engaged in sockpuppetry=== 4.1) Per private evidence, A Man In Black has abusively edited Wikipedia as an anonymous user, resulting in a medium length block of that IP address. A Man In Black evaded the block by editing as A Man In Black while the IP block was in effect, engaging in the same dispute where the IP was active. :''Passed 8 to 1 (with 1 abstention) on 19:29, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===A Man In Black has used his tools inappropriately=== 5) A Man In Black, despite being involved with Ikip, blocked him, and also twice deleted a template that Ikip had created.[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/A_Man_In_Black/Evidence#A_Man_In_Black_has_used_his_admin_tools_inappropriately_on_Ikip] :''Passed 8 to 0 (with 2 abstentions) on 19:29, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===A Man In Black has a history of edit-warring=== 6) A Man In Black has a long history of edit-warring during his tenure as an administrator.[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/A_Man_In_Black/Evidence#Evidence_presented_by_Ikip][http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/IncidentArchive211#Edit_warring_re_Magic:_The_Gathering_cards][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requests_for_bureaucratship/A_Man_In_Black&diff=142982844&oldid=142982028][http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/3RRArchive26#User:A_Man_In_Black_reported_by_MatthewFenton.C2.A0.28talk+.C2.B7+_contribs.29_.28Result:_warnings.29] :''Passed 10 to 0 on 19:29, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Ikip and A Man In Black have edit-warred === 7) A Man In Black and Ikip revert-warred over inclusion of the sentence "As an editor who actively supports the deletion of many articles, I object to what Article Rescue Squadron is doing" and a response to it at [[Wikipedia:Article Rescue Squadron/FAQ]]. This was slow-moving edit-warring until May 10. On May 15, A Man In Black removed the wording again [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290050088&oldid=289113765], sparking an edit-war that lasted from May 15 to 18, involving A Man In Black [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290172249&oldid=290116507][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290174520&oldid=290174226][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290391200&oldid=290387867][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290407012&oldid=290406829][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290407012&oldid=290406829][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290683585&oldid=290409869][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290685937&oldid=290685461][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290789783&oldid=290690964][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290806721&oldid=290799822], Ikip[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290094436&oldid=290050088][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290174822&oldid=290174520][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290402219&oldid=290391200], and others. The edit-war came to an end when AMIB self-reverted.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Article_Rescue_Squadron/FAQ&diff=290806801&oldid=290806721] Thereafter, A Man In Black was blocked and and Ikip was cautioned.[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/3RRArchive99#User:A_Man_In_Black_reported_by_User:Ikip_.28Result:_9_days_.29] :''Passed 9 to 0 (with 1 abstention) on 19:29, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Ikip has engaged in uncivil conduct=== 8) Ikip has engaged in attacks and uncivil comments towards A Man In Black.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:A_Man_In_Black&diff=291008510&oldid=290985820][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:A_Man_In_Black&diff=288436259&oldid=288436143][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_talk:Article_Rescue_Squadron&diff=next&oldid=268377211] :''Passed 5 to 2 (with 3 abstentions) on 19:29, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ==Remedies== ''Note: All remedies that refer to a period of time, for example to a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months, are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' ===A Man In Black desysopped=== 1) {{admin|A Man In Black}}’s administrator privileges are revoked. He may apply to have them reinstated at any time, either through the usual means or by appeal to the Committee. :''Passed 9 to 1 on 19:36, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===A Man in Black topic-banned=== 2) A Man In Black is topic-banned from the Article Rescue Squadron for one year. Broadly construed, A Man In Black may not contact, interact with, nor comment on in any capacity, from article space to project space, about the [[WP:ARS|Article Rescue Squadron]]. Should AMiB be found in violation of this, he may be blocked for the duration specified below. :''Passed 5 to 2 (with 3 abstentions) on 19:36, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' === A Man in Black restricted === 4) A Man in Black is subject to an editing restriction for one year. A Man in Black is limited to one revert per page per week (except for undisputable vandalism and BLP violations), and is required to discuss any content reversions on the page's talk page. Should A Man in Black exceed this limit or fail to discuss a content reversion, A Man in Black may be blocked for the duration specified in the enforcement ruling below :''Passed 8 to 0 (with 2 abstentions) on 19:36, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ===Ikip warned=== 5) {{userlinks|Ikip}} is warned to refrain from making large-scale edits which may be interpreted as [[WP:CANVASS|canvassing]] or making rude comments to users he’s in dispute with. :''Passed 6 to 3 (with 1 abstention) on 19:36, 27 June 2009 (UTC).'' ==Enforcement== {{Arbitration standard provisions}} ==Log of blocks, bans, and restrictions== {{Wikipedia:Arbitration Committee/Enforcement log section}} [[Category:Wikipedia arbitration cases|{{SUBPAGENAME}}]] {{NOINDEX}}

Watchlist all case pages: [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}&action=watch '''1'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Evidence&action=watch '''2'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Workshop&action=watch '''3'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Proposed_decision&action=watch '''4''']
Once the case is closed, editors may add to the [[#Log of blocks, bans, and restrictions]] as needed, but this page should not be edited otherwise. Please raise any questions at [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration#Requests for clarification]], and report violations of remedies at [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard/Arbitration enforcement]]. ==Involved parties== *{{userlinks|Flatscan}}, ''filing party'' *{{userlinks|A Nobody}} ==Statement by Flatscan== A Nobody has persisted in making copying edits that introduce [[WP:Copying within Wikipedia|attribution dependencies]] and interfere with the deletion process. Considering that AN continued with the similar merging during active AfDs until ''both'' the WT:AFD discussion and his RfC, Arbitration appears to be the only remaining venue. Recent activity: * 21 February 2010: [[WP:Articles for deletion/Zoe Graystone]] closes ''keep'', AN immediately merges it and related articles ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&dir=prev&offset=20100221163300&limit=23&target=A+Nobody contribs]) into [[List of Caprica characters]], but without redirecting. * 22 February 2010: I approach AN about a few questionable edits during February ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:A_Nobody&oldid=346114551#Copying_content permanent link]). AN does not respond, eventually removing the section via a botched move archive ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:A_Nobody&dir=prev&offset=20100224164600&limit=10&action=history history], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk%3AA_Nobody&diff=346114892&oldid=346114551&diffonly=1 diff]). * 7 March 2010: Shortly after commenting at [[WP:Articles for deletion/Baldwin P. "Bulletproof" Vess]], AN adds reception to [[Baldwin P. "Bulletproof" Vess]], then copies it to [[Big Boss (C.O.P.S.)]] ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&dir=prev&offset=20100307190100&limit=7&target=A+Nobody contribs]). I [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Big_Boss_(C.O.P.S.)&action=historysubmit&diff=348475099&oldid=348373988 clarify that the content was all contributed by A Nobody]. * 8 March 2010: AN removes a {{tl|prod}} from [[List of characters in Tron]], then copies a few sentences to [[Tron (film)]] ([http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&dir=prev&offset=20100308150500&limit=6&target=A+Nobody contribs]). [[User:Deor]] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tron_(film)&action=historysubmit&diff=348569223&oldid=348473872 removes the copied content]. If this case's scope is confined to the copying issue, I would be satisfied by a motion that restricts A Nobody from ''any'' copying. While I have only tried to resolve the copying issue, I agree that it is merely one of a number of problematic behaviors and that a full case may be appropriate. [[User:Flatscan|Flatscan]] ([[User talk:Flatscan|talk]]) 05:59, 14 March 2010 (UTC) ==Preliminary decisions== === Clerk notes === :''This area is used for notes by non-recused Clerks.'' *'''Recused''' '''[[User:MBisanz|MBisanz]]''' [[User talk:MBisanz|talk]] 14:16, 15 March 2010 (UTC) *'''Recused''', obviously. [[User:Lankiveil|Lankiveil]] ([[User talk:Lankiveil|speak to me]]) 11:36, 16 March 2010 (UTC). === Arbitrators' opinion on hearing this matter (3/2/1/1) === * Waiting for a comment from A Nobody (which it seems may be some time in coming), but I do have a question. To Flatscan, nothing in the cases you mention in your statement was deleted, and it appears as though A Nobody was diligent about linking to the source page titles in his edits, as is required when doing [[WP:SMERGE|"smerges"]]. So what exactly is the problem? I do see the lack of communication as an issue; while we cannot confirm medical issues and must respect user's privacy in this regard, the timing of those instances is admittedly odd. [[User:Hersfold|'''''Hersfold''''']] ([[User:Hersfold/t|t]]/[[User:Hersfold/a|a]]/[[Special:Contributions/Hersfold|c]]) 16:19, 14 March 2010 (UTC) *: '''Decline for now, to be looked at again if A Nobody returns'''. Several of the statements made here are concerning, but it is entirely impractical to attempt to hold an arbitration case with a main party unable and unwilling to participate. Should A Nobody return, I would also like this looked at again, and unless the situation changes considerably I'd likely move to accept the case. [[User:Hersfold|'''''Hersfold''''']] ([[User:Hersfold/t|t]]/[[User:Hersfold/a|a]]/[[Special:Contributions/Hersfold|c]]) 17:30, 15 March 2010 (UTC) * As A Nobody has left Wikipedia, my initial inclination would be to decline this with the understanding that if he returns to Wikipedia, in this guise or another, we can look at opening a case then. Iridescent's comments give me some pause, though; while I don't think ArbCom's competent to rule on the requirements of CC-BY-SA, if the merging-during-AFDs thing is an issue likely to remain live even after A Nobody's departure there might be something for us to do here. Would welcome further statements speaking to this issue. [[User:Steve Smith|Steve Smith]] ([[User talk:Steve Smith|talk]]) 04:06, 15 March 2010 (UTC) * '''Decline with caveats''' While I would generally be suspicious of any user who has the history of disappearing whenever something involving advanced stages of dispute resolution is proposed against them doing so, I have to take the statement of A Nobody on his talk page of medical issues, etcetera at face value. However, I do not want this to be seen as carte blanche.. if and when he returns, I would like to see this resume if there is a problem, and I'd ask the committee to take this prior history into their decision to accept or decline any case (and not claim that the evidence is too old or what have you). [[User:SirFozzie|SirFozzie]] ([[User talk:SirFozzie|talk]]) 04:12, 15 March 2010 (UTC) * '''Conditional acceptance''' per set out in the motion. - [[User:Mailer diablo|Mailer Diablo]] 10:10, 17 March 2010 (UTC) * '''Accept and adjourn''' I too am willing to take [[User:A Nobody|A Nobody's]] statement at face value, there are nevertheless underlying concerns. Best is to accept this case but adjourn it ''sine die'' pending this editor's return, if ever, to editing.  [[User:Roger Davies|'''Roger Davies''']] [[User talk:Roger Davies|'''talk''']] 10:21, 17 March 2010 (UTC) * '''Accept''' but as below, hold until/unless A Nobody returns. [[User:Shell_Kinney|Shell]] [[User_talk:Shell_Kinney|babelfish]] 11:59, 17 March 2010 (UTC) *'''Recuse''', as I see this as part and parcel of the long-running conduct issues surrounding fiction articles and stubs and other related matters, a topic and conduct area that I am more likely to present evidence about than be able to properly arbitrate, though, as presented, this case could (and should) cleave narrowly to specific conduct issues with individuals, and any case should avoid getting dragged into wider issues of article content. [[User:Carcharoth|Carcharoth]] ([[User talk:Carcharoth|talk]]) 02:21, 18 March 2010 (UTC) === Motion === This case is accepted, but will not be opened unless and until {{user|A Nobody}} returns to Wikipedia. If A Nobody does so under any account or I.P., he/she is required to notify the Committee. '''Enacted''' ~ Amory ''([[User:Amorymeltzer|u]] • [[User talk:Amorymeltzer|t]] • [[Special:Contributions/Amorymeltzer|c]])'' 22:48, 19 March 2010 (UTC) ;Support #Proposed. [[User:Steve Smith|Steve Smith]] ([[User talk:Steve Smith|talk]]) 18:28, 16 March 2010 (UTC) # [[User:SirFozzie|SirFozzie]] ([[User talk:SirFozzie|talk]]) 19:52, 16 March 2010 (UTC) # [[User:Mailer diablo|Mailer Diablo]] 10:10, 17 March 2010 (UTC) #  [[User:Roger Davies|'''Roger Davies''']] [[User talk:Roger Davies|'''talk''']] 10:21, 17 March 2010 (UTC) # — [[User:Coren|Coren]] [[User Talk:Coren|(talk)]] 10:45, 17 March 2010 (UTC) # [[User:Shell_Kinney|Shell]] [[User_talk:Shell_Kinney|babelfish]] 12:00, 17 March 2010 (UTC) # With the caveat that should A Nobody return under another account, and not notify the Committee, he will face sanctions. [[User:KnightLago|KnightLago]] ([[User talk:KnightLago|talk]]) 18:48, 17 March 2010 (UTC) # [[User:Hersfold|'''''Hersfold''''']] ([[User:Hersfold/t|t]]/[[User:Hersfold/a|a]]/[[Special:Contributions/Hersfold|c]]) 20:41, 17 March 2010 (UTC) # — [[User:Rlevse|Rlevse]] • [[User_talk:Rlevse|Talk]] • 22:59, 17 March 2010 (UTC) # [[User:Kirill Lokshin|Kirill]] [[User talk:Kirill Lokshin|[talk]]] [[User:Kirill Lokshin/Professionalism|[prof]]] 02:23, 18 March 2010 (UTC) # With the caveat that if A Nobody returns but states unambiguously that he will not repeat the disputed behavior, and adheres to such promise, a case might not then be necessary. [[User:Newyorkbrad|Newyorkbrad]] ([[User talk:Newyorkbrad|talk]]) 06:35, 18 March 2010 (UTC) Noting that this motion supersedes the accept/decline voting in the section above. [[User:Newyorkbrad|Newyorkbrad]] ([[User talk:Newyorkbrad|talk]]) 17:59, 18 March 2010 (UTC) # [[User:FayssalF|FayssalF]] - [[User talk:FayssalF|''Wiki me up''® ]] 07:24, 18 March 2010 (UTC) # This has happened ''after'' a case was opened, and I think it's a good precedent to guarantee against avoiding the issue by a well-timed disappearance. [[User:Cool Hand Luke|Cool Hand]] ''[[User talk:Cool Hand Luke|Luke]]'' 15:29, 19 March 2010 (UTC) ;Oppose ;Abstain === Motion 2 === [[User:A Nobody]] is banned indefinitely from Wikipedia. This ban will be lifted and Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/A Nobody opened at such time as A Nobody agrees to participate in that case. *'''Support''': Cool Hand Luke, Coren, KnightLago, Mailer diablo, Rlevse, Shell Kinney, SirFozzie, Steve Smith *'''Oppose''': None *'''Not voting''': Kirill Lokshin, Newyorkbrad, Risker, Roger Davies *'''Recuse''': Carcharoth (See [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia%3AArbitration_Committee%2FNoticeboard&action=historysubmit&diff=363094773&oldid=362101123]) =Final decision (none yet) = ''All numbering based on [[/Proposed decision]], where vote counts and comments are also available.'' ==Principles== ==Findings of fact== ==Remedies== ''Note: All remedies that refer to a period of time, for example to a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months, are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' ==Enforcement== ==Log of blocks, bans, and restrictions== {{Wikipedia:Arbitration Committee/Enforcement log section}} [[Category:Wikipedia arbitration cases|{{SUBPAGENAME}}]]
